sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – full 2027 allocation proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. To secure supply from 2027-01-01, we propose a firm two-year commitment covering our full need of 23,400 pcs per year at EUR 29.89/unit, with a 56-day lead time.

For reference, our recent orders po:4500014383-10 (2026-09-07) and po:4500014436-10 (2026-09-21) were both placed at EUR 29.89/unit. We cite these as past prices only.

In return for full allocation, we can offer you scheduling flexibility within the commitment. What adjustment on your side would help make this full allocation work?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – full 2027 allocation proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your request for a 24-month commitment covering 23,400 pieces per year. While we can accommodate this volume and the 56-day lead time, past prices are no longer applicable to current allocations. 

We can offer EUR 31.90 per unit for this extended commitment. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our offer features a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Re: Full allocation 2027 – extended commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for moving to full volume and the 56-day lead time. To answer your question: we can commit to our full 23,400 pcs per year.

We are prepared to go further on both term and price. We propose EUR 30.10/unit for 23,400 pcs per year over a 36-month term, with a 56-day lead time. The third year gives you firm, long-term volume for your capacity planning. In return, we need full allocation and a price below your current EUR 31.90.

Does the additional year allow you to improve your price?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Full allocation 2027 – extended commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal for a 36-month term and adjust our offer to EUR 31.80 per unit. 

You claim the third year benefits our capacity planning; please provide the data quantifying this value. Our calculation remains internal. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer comprises a price of €31.80 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This proposal remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – 36-month full-volume package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming the full 23,400 pcs per year, the 36-month term and the 56-day lead time.

We would like to conclude on exactly this structure. We propose EUR 30.96/unit for 23,400 pcs per year over 36 months, with a 56-day lead time and all other terms as in your quotation. This gives you three years of firm, full-volume business.

Could you approve this precise package on your side?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – 36-month full-volume package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

As communicated, our previous offer was final. Consequently, we withdraw from this negotiation. Please be advised that we are withdrawing from this negotiation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.
